question: Are users below 18 identified and verifiable parental consent obtained before processing their personal data?
evidence_required: Age-gate screenshots and parental consent logs showing purpose and timestamp
recommended_fix: Implement age identification and a verifiable parental-consent workflow before onboarding under-18 users.
notes: Rule 10(1) requires due diligence that the consenting adult is identifiable.

question: Are personal data, traffic data and processing logs retained for at least one year before erasure?
evidence_required: Retention schedule and deletion job records showing the one-year floor
recommended_fix: Define a retention schedule that enforces the one-year minimum for data and logs, then evidence the deletion job.
notes: Applies to every Data Fiduciary, not only Third Schedule classes.
